ja.description:
句動詞と英熟語（イディオム）に苦手を感じていませんか？

Izzyは、句動詞と英熟語（イディオム）に特化した英語学習アプリです。

・3,000以上の句動詞とイディオムを、日本語またはやさしい英語で確認
・look for、look intoなど、同じ動詞の表現をまとめて比較
・36種類の前置詞・副詞をコアイメージで理解
・エヴィングハウスの忘却曲線をベースとした復習ストラテジー
・お気に入り、個人メモ、並べ替え、学習日数の記録
・句動詞やイディオムの聞き流し

アカウントの作成は不要です。

無料プランでは句動詞50個・イディオム50個とすべてのコアイメージが学べます。
Izzy Proを一度購入すると、3,000以上の表現の閲覧・復習と、すべての背景・フォントが使えます。サブスクリプションはありません。価格はアプリ内で確認できます。

設定・ヘルプは日本語と英語に対応し、iOSのアプリ言語に合わせて表示されます。

en-US.name: Izzy: Phrasal Verbs & Idioms
en-US.subtitle: Make English your own
en-US.promotionalText: Focus on 3,000+ phrasal verbs and idioms. Reviews timed to the forgetting curve and core images for prepositions and particles help them stay with you.
en-US.description:
Make English your own.

Izzy helps English learners turn familiar phrasal verbs and idioms into language they can use in conversation.

• Browse 3,000+ phrasal verbs and idioms, with explanations in Japanese or easy English.
• Choose 1–50 new expressions a day, with due reviews counted separately.
• Listen continuously to expressions, meanings and examples, including in the background.
• Group expressions by their verb, such as look for and look into.
• Explore 36 consistent diagrams for prepositions and particles.
• Try a reply before revealing an example, then use the expression yourself.
• Return to phrases after a gap, guided by your own recall ratings.
• See your daily activity and upcoming reviews in Stats.
• Save phrases, add personal notes, sort your collection, and track practice days.

No app account is required.

Practice is free. The free plan includes 50 phrasal verbs and 50 idioms with spaced reviews, all core images, 2 backgrounds and 2 phrase fonts. A single Izzy Pro purchase unlocks all 3,000+ phrases for browsing and spaced reviews, plus every background and phrase font. No subscription. See the current price in the app.

Izzy supports solo speaking practice. It does not provide automatic pronunciation scores or live conversations with a partner.

Settings and help are available in Japanese and English, following the iOS app language independently of the lesson explanation language.
